# Repody design system

Read before any UI work. The full reasoning is in `docs/design/ui-strategy.md`.

## Direction

Linear's method (inverted L chrome, structure felt not seen, hierarchy by brightness, one accent,
dense and aligned, keyboard first), our own brand. Character: calm, exact, quick. World: a
reviewer's desk. Signature: the status glyph (`components/ui/status-glyph.tsx`), one family for
every judged thing, always in a fixed 14px column.

## Tokens (generated by `lib/theme/generate.ts`, never hard-coded)

- Surfaces: `canvas` (behind the chrome) < `panel` (content, brightest) ; `raised` (inside a panel),
  `overlay` (menus, dialogs), `field` (inputs, inset).
- Ink: `ink`, `ink-2`, `ink-3`, `ink-4`. Lines: `line`, `line-strong`. Washes: `hover`, `selected`.
- Accent: `accent`, `accent-hover`, `accent-ink` (text), `accent-wash`, `on-accent`, `focus`.
- Status: `pass|warn|fail` with `-ink` and `-wash`.
- Brand inputs per deployment: `REPODY_BRAND_NAME`, `_LOGO_URL`, `_BASE`, `_ACCENT`, `_CONTRAST`
  (30 to 100), `_RADIUS` (0 to 12).

## Type and spacing

- Inter (optical sizing), `cv01` `ss03`. Weights 400 / 510 (`font-medium`) / 590 (`font-semibold`).
- Sizes: `text-2xs` 11, `text-xs` 12, `text-sm` 13 (the UI), `text-base` 15, `text-lg` 18,
  `text-xl` 20, `text-2xl` 24. Numbers `tabular-nums`. Sentence case, no uppercase labels.
- 4px grid. Nav rows 28px, controls 32px (`h-8`), list rows 40 to 44px, page header 44px (`h-11`).
- Page body: `max-w-[1200px] px-4 py-6 md:px-8 md:py-8`; lists run edge to edge (`<Page bleed>`).

## Patterns

- `Page` (header bar + body) and `Section` (title, hint, actions) in `components/layout/page.tsx`.
- Framed group: `rounded-lg shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--line)]`, rows divided by `divide-line`.
- Lists are rows, not cards: glyph, title (ink, medium), meta (ink-3, xs, tabular), time at the end.
- Inline editing: inputs look like text until hover (`hover:bg-hover`) or focus (accent inset ring).
- Destructive actions live in a `…` menu and confirm in `ConfirmDialog`.
- Empty states: one sentence of what goes here, one action.

## Motion

Motion (`motion/react`) with `MotionConfig reducedMotion="user"`. Frequent actions are instant.
Press 0.97, menus 150ms from their trigger, dialogs 200ms, exits shorter. Ease
`cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)`, springs with bounce 0. Expressive motion only for the run timeline
(and its GPU warm-up card), a finished verdict, and the selection bar.

## Never

Gradients, glows, blur, coloured shadows, icon tiles, uppercase tracked labels, KPI sparklines,
more than one accent, `transition-all`, raw palette classes (`bg-gray-*`, hex) in components.
